label: Mathura peda
note: The peda originated in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh; thick semi-soft brown balls of khoa, sugar and cardamom; the word comes from Sanskrit piṇḍa, a lump; Bhojanakutūhala (17th c.) describes milk and sugar with cardamom, cloves and pepper

about.text: The original peda, from Mathura in Uttar Pradesh: thick, semi-soft brown balls of khoa, sugar and cardamom.
